This directory contains a pinned copy of the EmulatorJS player and its threaded Azahar 3DS core. It contains emulator code and no game files.

Runtime and core artifacts were copied from https://cdn.emulatorjs.org/nightly/data/ on 2026-11-11. The Azahar build report records the core build on 2026-07-25. The stable version metadata is included locally. The player bundle's version metadata URL was changed to point at that local file.

EmulatorJS source and build instructions: https://github.com/EmulatorJS/EmulatorJS
Azahar port source: https://github.com/EmulatorJS/azahar
Core build tooling: https://github.com/EmulatorJS/build

See the accompanying license files.
